MINUTES OF THE REGULAR MEETING
  CITY OF NORWALK
  INTERNATIONAL FRIENDSHIP COMMISSION
  September 8, 2026

Chair Carbajal called the meeting to order at 5:11 p.m. in Conference Room 4, Norwalk
City Hall, 12700 Norwalk Boulevard, Norwalk, California. Responding to roll call were
Chair Carbajal, Vice Chair Gomez, Commissioner Flores, and Commissioner Salas. Also,
present were Jesus Gomez, City Manager and Amber Bulosan, Management Analyst.

APPROVAL OF MINUTES

Vice Chair Gomez motioned for the approval of the minutes of the International Friendship
Commission Regular Meeting minutes that was held on August 11, 2026. Commissioner
Flores seconded the motion.

MOTION CARRIED BY THE FOLLOWING ROLL CALL VOTE:

AYES:  Chair Carbajal, Vice  Chair  Gomez,  Commissioner  Flores,
  Commissioner Salas
NOES:  None
ABSENT: None
ABSTAIN: None

REPORTS

Discuss a Rescheduled Trip to Zacatecas, Mexico

The Commission discussed possible travel opportunities to Zacatecas, Mexico through
the coming year. They discussed activities such as meetings with local leadership and
attendance to cultural events and concerts.

STAFF COMMENTS

COMMISSIONER COMMENTS

Vice Chair Gomez invited the Commissioners to a celebration on September 26th for the
Senorita Zacatecas Beauty Pageant. He also invited the Commission to another event
that will be held on November 14th.

ORAL COMMUNICATIONS

No public comment

ADJOURNMENT
 Being no further business to come before the International Friendship Commission, the
meeting was adjourned at 5:54 p.m.

_______________________________
CHAIR
Maria Carbajal
